tools.description: Search memories using hybrid search (BM25 keyword + vector similarity). Searches the 'global' context plus the specified context, which defaults to the project's .agent-memory context if present (unless no_global is true, which requires a context). Fuzzy matching is on by default, set fuzzy:false for exact-word precision. Use to discover relevant prior knowledge, architectural decisions, user preferences, or solutions across sessions. Do NOT use search when you already have a memory's id or name (use 'get' instead). Contexts group memories; contexts cannot be created or deleted by agents (the user creates them via the CLI). Example: search(query="JWT auth middleware setup", context="backend").

context.description: Optional context slug to search in addition to 'global' (defaults to the project's .agent-memory context).

fuzzy.description: Enable fuzzy matching (default true). Set to false for exact-word precision.

limit.description: Maximum number of hits to return (1-50, default 8).

no_global.description: Exclude the 'global' context. Requires a context (explicit or the project default).

query.description: Search query text to find relevant memories.

tools.name: search

tools.description: Retrieve memories or context information. Call with NO arguments to orient yourself: returns the user's global instructions file (readme.md) and all active contexts (permanent/expiring) with memory counts. Call with only 'context' to list that context's memories (name, id, version, size). Call with 'id' or 'name'+'context' (context defaults to the project's .agent-memory context, else 'global') to retrieve the full markdown note with metadata headers (id, version, tags). Use 'version' for subsequent safe upserts. Do not pass both 'id' and 'name'. Example: get(context="backend", name="auth/jwt").

context.description: Context slug. If used alone, lists that context's memories. If used with name, scopes the memory lookup (defaults to the project's .agent-memory context, else 'global').

id.description: Stable memory ID to fetch. Mutually exclusive with name.

name.description: Memory name to fetch within a context. Mutually exclusive with id.

tools.name: get

tools.description: Create or update a markdown memory note. Use to persist knowledge, decisions, or session logs across sessions. IDs are stable identifiers. Resolution: pass 'id' to update/rename an existing memory; pass 'name' to update-or-create; omit both to create an unnamed memory (<id>.md). Context defaults to the project's .agent-memory context if present, else 'global'; agents cannot create contexts (user creates them via CLI). Set 'if_version' to avoid overwriting concurrent edits (fetch version first with 'get'). Set 'append: true' to add lines to the end of a log. Example: upsert(context="backend", name="auth/jwt", body="Use RS256 for tokens.", tags=["auth","jwt"], if_version=2).

append.description: If true, append body to existing content instead of overwriting.

body.description: Markdown content of the memory (max 1 MiB).

context.description: Target context slug (defaults to the project's .agent-memory context, else 'global'). Must already exist.

id.description: Optional memory ID to update or rename.

if_version.description: Perform write only if current memory version equals this number.

name.description: Optional memory name (max 200 chars). If id is omitted, updates or creates by name.

tags.description: Optional tags (max 20 tags, each up to 64 chars).

tools.name: upsert

tools.description: Delete a memory permanently by its stable 'id'. Use only when the user explicitly requests deletion or when a memory is completely obsolete. Prefer 'upsert' to correct, update, or supersede information rather than deleting. Contexts and the default instructions file ('global/readme.md') cannot be deleted. Memory IDs can be found via 'search' or 'get'. Example: delete(id="mem_01h2x3y4z5").
tools.name: delete
